vdel_card.note: vdel_card v: the card G - v, the subgraph induced on the vertices other than v; equal to upstream's induced [set~ v] (vdel_cardE) and of order #|G| - 1 (card_vdel_card).

same_deck.note: same_deck G H: a bijection f of the vertex sets with vdel_card v isomorphic to vdel_card (f v) for every v; the multiset-of-cards reading (every card counted with multiplicity); forces equal orders (same_deck_card); no order guard (the conjecture's three-vertex guards live in the statement).

reconstructible.note: reconstructible G: every H with the same deck is isomorphic to G; no guard.

same_edge_deck.note: same_edge_deck G H: a bijection f of the edge index types {e | e \in E(G)} with del_edge_set G [set e] isomorphic to del_edge_set H [set f e] for every edge; forces equal edge counts (same_edge_deck_card_edge); any two edgeless graphs have the same edge deck (edgeless_same_edge_deck), so a positive edge-count guard is needed and lives in the statements.

edge_reconstructible.note: edge_reconstructible G: every H with the same edge deck is isomorphic to G; no guard.
